verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a proper banner with a legible SOLSTICE wordmark and a dominant headline, but it is cramped: the two circles are piled behind the end of 'fizz', the CTA pill is oversized and jammed against the 3-line body copy and the right edge, and the bottle nearly touches the top and bottom edges. B shrinks the SOLSTICE logo to a tiny, barely legible mark stuck in the top-left corner and makes the body copy small. Its bottle is nearly cropped top and bottom, the CTA floats on the green circle, and there is dead space under the centred text block, so the hierarchy and the brand both feel weaker.
